provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source review and execution audit
limitations: This assumes the generator's domain: an even-sided square input split into equal quadrants, at least one non-background cell in each count quadrant, and a fill quadrant with no background colour. Odd or non-square inputs are handled by splitting at floor(R/2) and floor(C/2), but the generator never produces them. Demonstrations are not used, because the roles follow fully from d4 and palette. No fixture contradicts the uniform rule. I have not run any tests.
